data.title: Port of Tauranga gains fast-track approval for major Stella Passage expansion
data.description:
Port of Tauranga ( (NZ:POT) ) just unveiled an update.

Port of Tauranga has secured fast-track approval, subject to conditions and potential appeals, for its Stella Passage development under the Fast-track Approvals Act 2024. The company views the project as essential strategic infrastructure to accommodate future freight growth, bolster supply chain resilience and efficiency, and reduce logistics costs for New Zealand’s traders.

The development will extend the Sulphur Point container berth by 385 metres in two stages and lengthen the Mount Maunganui wharves by 315 metres within the port’s existing footprint. It also includes land reclamation behind the new wharves and dredging of the passage, marking a major capacity upgrade that could enhance Port of Tauranga’s competitive position in container handling and bulk cargo operations once conditions are met and appeals resolved.

data.title: Iondrive’s Updated IONSolv Study Shows Strong Economics for U.S. Rare Earth Module
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Southern Gold Limited ( (AU:ION) ).

Iondrive Limited has released an updated technical and economic evaluation for a single IONSolv module in the United States, indicating a post-tax net present value of US$243 million and annual EBITDA of US$62.1 million on revenue of US$121.8 million. The module, designed to process 2,402 tonnes of feedstock per year, is expected to produce about 630 tonnes of rare earth oxides, mainly neodymium, praseodymium and dysprosium, with development capital estimated at US$11.9 million and a ten-year operating life.

The evaluation is based on independently validated testwork and assumes high recovery rates for key rare earth elements, although full recovery through to final product still needs to be demonstrated via integrated testwork. While key assumptions on feedstock grade, supply availability and product pricing remain uncontracted, the study supports Iondrive’s plan for a first commercial IONSolv module in Oklahoma, underscoring the potential for capital-light rare earth recycling and strengthening its strategic position in the U.S. critical minerals market.

data.title: Yari flags flexible coal product mix and growth potential at Arcadia project
data.description:
Consolidated Zinc Limited ( (AU:YAR) ) has issued an update.

Yari Resources has identified multiple product pathways at its recently acquired Arcadia Coal Project in Queensland’s Bowen Basin, with coal-quality review results indicating potential for semi-soft coking, PCI and high-energy thermal coal. The project’s coal averages about 10% in-situ ash, suggesting high-yield thermal product potential, while selective mining and beneficiation could deliver smaller volumes with semi-soft coking characteristics.

The company is expanding Arcadia’s technical database, incorporating additional historical drilling and five cored petroleum and coal seam gas wells that were not included in the 2017 geological model to assess resource growth. Management says Arcadia’s flexibility to target different products across the deposit supports Yari’s broader resource expansion and consolidation strategy in the Bowen Basin, potentially strengthening its position in a competitive coal district and enhancing future development options.

data.title: Kintor completes year-long safety trial for whitening ingredient KT-939
data.description:
Kintor Pharmaceutical Ltd ( (HK:9939) ) has shared an announcement.

Kintor Pharmaceutical announced the successful completion of a year-long human safety trial for KT-939, its in-house developed tyrosinase inhibitor designed for whitening and freckle-removal cosmetic applications. The open-label study followed 114 subjects using a 0.2% topical formulation continuously for 52 weeks and reported no adverse skin reactions, confirming the strong safety profile seen in earlier interim data.

Conducted under new long-term human use testing guidelines issued by China’s National Medical Products Administration, the trial results form a key component of KT-939’s registration dossier. Kintor is now expediting the final submission of application materials to regulators, a step that could accelerate commercialisation of KT-939 and strengthen the company’s positioning in the high-demand cosmetic raw materials segment if approval is granted.
